PP16 1.0 - QUICK HELP
====================

START: load a DOS mouse driver, CD to the installed directory, then PP16.
Keep PP16UI.P16 in that directory beside PP16.EXE.

DRAWING
  Left drag              Draw with the selected tool and foreground colour.
  Right click/drag       Sample a foreground colour from the image.
  Left palette click     Select foreground colour.
  Right palette click    Select background colour.
  Tab                    Swap foreground and background colours.
  Size - / +             Set Brush, Line, Circle and Square size: 1 to 5.
  Bucket Fill            Fill a connected area with the foreground colour.
  Action / Clear         Clear to black; Alt+C also clears to black.
  Clear to Colour        Clear to the foreground colour.
  Ctrl+Z                 Undo one completed document action; there is no Redo.
  Escape                 Cancel an unfinished stroke, shape, paste or dialog.

SELECTION AND CLIPBOARD
  Select + left drag     Select a rectangle.
  Right-click Select     Toggle rectangle/ellipse selection.
  Ctrl + selection drag  Constrain to square/circle.
  Ctrl+C                 Copy the selection.
  Ctrl+X or Cut icon     Copy and clear the selection to background colour.
  Ctrl+V or Clipboard    Begin floating paste placement.
  Mouse / arrows         Move the floating paste.
  Left click / Enter     Commit the paste. Escape cancels it.
  Edit / Paste Behind    Restrict paste to background-colour destinations.
  Clipboard CLR          Empty the clipboard.
  Clipboard buttons      Mirror, rotate clockwise, or scale the clipboard.
  Scale left/right       Add/remove one pixel in width and height.

VIEW AND FILES
  2 / 4 / 8              Choose zoom.
  Arrow keys             Pan by one image pixel.
  Shift + arrows         Pan by half the visible view.
  Image preview drag     Centre the view at the pointer.
  F4                     Toggle the canvas grid.
  F1                     Open built-in Quick Help.
  File / New             Start a blank black image; unsaved work is protected.
  File / Save, Save As   Save the image as NAME.P16.
  Save As NAME.CLP       Save the current clipboard instead of the image.
  File / Open            Open a .P16 image or .CLP clipboard.
  File / Exit            Return to DOS; choose Cancel to retain unsaved work.

Use DOS 8.3 names, such as HERO.P16, in the current directory. File dialogs
do not browse directories. Never save your own drawing as PP16UI.P16.
Replacement backups and failed temporary writes are kept below TRASH.

TROUBLESHOOTING
  Refused/unsupported    Check Tandy hardware/emulation and 640 KiB installed
                        RAM. PP16 also refuses conflicting video memory use.
  NO MOUSE              Load a compatible DOS mouse driver before PP16.
  Missing tool icons    Restore the supplied PP16UI.P16 beside PP16.EXE.
  Save fails            Check free space, write protection and the filename;
                        preserve the displayed TRASH recovery folder.
  INSTALL refuses       Choose a new folder; it protects existing files.

The full instructions, credits and file-recovery details are in PP16.DOC.
